limitations: Full captions40–43 read; no numerical values digitized from instructor DNS graphs and no comprehensive board/video audit
Wall law calculations assume positive shear, smooth attached equilibrium layer and a declared fit; no generic roughness or separated-flow guarantee
Illustrative mesh ranges are guidance to check against actual model/flow, not sufficient convergence criteria
Near-wall expansions require a smooth impermeable no-slip wall, incompressibility and suitable derivative/moment regularity; degenerate leading coefficients can vanish
Manufactured random field is a kinematic check, not an unforced Navier–Stokes solution or turbulent DNS
No spatial RANS solver or accuracy benchmark performed; numerical tests cover declared restricted relations
